# FUNVISIS Tracks Seismic Activity and Tremors Across Venezuela – Archyde On Saturday, August 1, 2026, the Fundación Venezolana de Investigaciones Seismológicas recorded seismic activity across Venezuela\. The state-backed seismological agency tracks tectonic movements nationwide, publishing official epicenter coordinates, depths, and moment magnitudes to keep the public informed of real-time geological shifts in the region\. ## Tracking Seismological Activity Through FUNVISIS Monitoring seismic events in a geologically active nation requires continuous data collection from sensitive instruments deployed across vulnerable fault lines\. The Fundación Venezolana de Investigaciones Seismológicas, commonly known as FUNVISIS, operates as the primary official scientific authority responsible for detecting, recording, and analyzing earthquakes throughout the country\. When ground motion occurs, seismologists at the agency process raw waveforms to determine exact hypocenter depths and magnitudes\.
